zh.title: 美國航空推出243英里空中巴士A321XLR短程航線
zh.summary: 美國航空推出空中巴士A321XLR客機航線；展示座艙科技與大型螢幕
body: 美國航空正式推出航程僅243英里的最新超短程飛行服務，並採用空中巴士A321XLR客機執飛。這款客機原本屬於超長程窄體客機，此次投入極短距離的航線營運，呈現出客機部署上的特殊規劃。
根據相關訊息，在這項短程航班營運中，空中巴士A321XLR展現了全新的機艙科技裝備。相關硬體設施包含了尺寸更大的螢幕，為搭乘旅客提供機上視聽設備。
此外，該款客機座艙內也配備了經過強化的座椅供電選項。這些機艙科技與硬體設施的展現，讓搭乘該超短程航線的旅客能夠體驗到新型客機的座艙設備。

en.title: American Airlines Launches 243-Mile Airbus A321XLR Short Hop
en.summary: American Airlines launches 243-mile Airbus A321XLR flights; new tech and larger screens highlighted.
body: American Airlines has launched new ultra-short flight operations utilizing the Airbus A321XLR aircraft, covering a sector distance of just 243 miles. The service places an ultra-long-range narrowbody jet onto a short-haul route segment.

The deployment of the Airbus A321XLR aircraft on this short flight provides an early look at the aircraft's new interior features and cabin technology. The onboard amenities revealed during the flight include larger passenger display screens.

In addition to the expanded passenger display screens, the cabin setup introduces enhanced in-seat power options for travelers. These interior features showcase the hardware and technology integrated into American Airlines' new narrowbody fleet.
